known_facts_book1: A sky fairy, the sweetest, merriest and most reckless of the dancing Daughters of the Rainbow, whose home is the Cloud Palaces in the sky.
Is stranded on earth for the second time after dancing down the arch of the bow and lingering on the ground until it lifted without her.
Cannot be injured by a nome, cannot be caught by Guph or Ruggedo, and flits from place to place faster than they can grab.
Sips a few dewdrops by moonlight for refreshment, and is served a dish of fresh sparkling dewdrops at Queen Erma's feast.
Refuses Ruggedo's offer to make her Queen of all his nomes and live in his jeweled cavern.
Is the one who wakes Quox — not by pounding on his eyelids, which fails, but by jerking the pearl necklace and the great locket around his neck.
Names the rule that every charm has its antidote, which is what forces Ruggedo to try to remember how to undo the ugliness.
Breaks the charm of ugliness with her kiss, having never kissed a mortal man in all the thousands of years she has existed.
The Rain King is her uncle; when the rain comes and the clouds break, the Rainbow descends to her feet and her sisters take her home.
Leaves before the end of the book and does not go to the Land of Oz.

known_relations_book1.Betsy Bobbin: Her friend and fellow guest of the Queen of Light.
known_relations_book1.Shaggy Man: Whom the Love Magnet makes her love, and whose brother she restores with a kiss.
known_relations_book1.Quox: The dragon she alone manages to wake.
known_relations_book1.the Ugly One: The man whose enchantment her fairy kiss breaks.
known_relations_book1.Ruggedo: The Nome King who covets her and cannot touch her.

known_facts_book1: A copper mechanical man engraved 'SMITH & TINKER'S Patent Double-Action, Extra-Responsive, Thought-Creating, Perfect-Talking MECHANICAL MAN', guaranteed to work perfectly for a thousand years.
Is wound in three places by three separate keys: thinking under the left arm (No. 1), speaking under the right arm (No. 2), walking and action in the middle of the back (No. 3).
Was sent by Ozma to find the Shaggy Man and tell him where his brother was, and was transported to the spot by Glinda in the wink of an eye.
Was met on arrival by Ruggedo, who threw him down an old dry well at a crossroads, where he lay run-down until Shaggy hauled him up with the windlass hook.
His machinery will not allow him to lie, nor allow his thoughts to think falsely — which is why Tititi-Hoochoo accepts his account and seats him on the throne.
Is made the Private Soldier of the Army of Oogaboo after Files resigns, carrying Files's gun, and is honored above all the officers by the Great Jinjin.
Marches alone into Ruggedo's cavern, avoids the covered pit that swallows all the officers and the Queen, and declares the King conquered.
Is tripped by Kaliko kicking his knee-joints, then pinned to the floor under a heavy diamond, and is nearly melted in a white-hot gold crucible.
Opens the barred door at last by pounding the King's gong, which brings Kaliko running.
Is transported back to Ozma's palace in Oz by the Wizard's magic before the others, and praises Betsy as almost as nice as Dorothy herself.

known_relations_book1.Shaggy Man: His old friend, whom Ozma sent him to assist and who pulls him from the well.
known_relations_book1.Betsy Bobbin: Winds him up and promises to keep him wound.
known_relations_book1.Ruggedo: The Nome King who threw him down the well and wanted to melt him into copper pennies.
known_relations_book1.Ann Soforth: The Queen whose entire Army he becomes.
known_relations_book1.Quox: The dragon who scorns him as a dummy that runs down.
known_relations_book1.Tititi-Hoochoo: The Jinjin who honors him with a seat on the throne.
